correctness.rationale: A family of n odd five-cycles gives the exact frustrated-bond lower bound ceil(n/2). The explicit 8-state transfer gives trace(T(x)^n) exactly, and its scaled determinant has D0=1-3t^4+t^8 and D1=-2(t^3+t^5). Formal log determinant converts the first normalized coefficient into 2n times a Fibonacci number. The coefficient is strictly positive for all odd n>=5, proving attainment and completeness. A symbolic matrix reconstruction and 28 exact transfer computations plus three exhaustive spin enumerations corroborate the algebra; experiments alone are not the proof.

value.rationale: Odd n produces an inner rim that is one cycle rather than the two inner rim cycles of even n. This is a physically meaningful topological sector of an infinite family of uniformly frustrated cubic spin graphs. Its exact ground-state multiplicity is not a routine isolated graph count: it has distinct n modulo 4 Fibonacci laws, a sharp max-cut energy, and a positive thermodynamic residual entropy density. The natural question is the all-n zero-field ground-state classification, not arbitrary slices or parameter substitutions.
